The locus of a point P such that A'B'C' is perpsective to the anticevian triangle of P is the cubic K707. The locus of a point P such that A'B'C' is paralogic to the cevian triangle of P is the cubic K211. The locus of a point P such that A'B'C' is paralogic to the anticevian triangle of P is a cubic; see just below for an equation. (Peter Moses, January 8, 2019)
